A '''podrace gambler''' stood in [[Watto/Legends|Watto's]] box to view the [[Boonta Eve Classic (32 BBY)/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], and bet on [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to win the race.<ref name="EpI" />

Anakin did win, and since Watto bet against Skywalker, he had to pay this individual after the race.<ref name="EpI" />

==Behind the scenes==
This individual can be seen twice in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. The first is in Watto's box during the first lap of the race, and the second is after the race when Watto is forced to pay them a presumably hefty sum, due to the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] later complaining to [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]].<ref name="EpI" />
